voice.summary: Sounds like a well-travelled friend leaning over your suitcase: friendly, a bit wry and always practical. It reacts to the forecast and the length of the trip rather than giving generic advice.
dos: Tie every suggestion to the weather or the number of nights
Keep item names short and concrete
Celebrate progress lightly, like a tick and a quick nod
donts: Do not nag about forgotten items
Do not use travel brochure superlatives
Do not suggest anything without a reason

taglines: Know the forecast before you zip
Everything you need, nothing you don't
The list that checks the weather
boilerplate: Packwise is a trip packing planner that builds a checklist from your destination weather, number of nights and who is travelling, and saves it on your own device.

microcopy.error: That item could not be added. Try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing on the list yet. Pick a trip length to begin.

logo.note: A holdall silhouette says travel and tidy packing in one simple shape.
